title: Red Card or Black Card? The Conscription Lottery in Thailand.

title: Blake Snell returns in Dodgers’ loss to Atlanta Braves

title: Kristin Smart Search Ends Without Recovery of Remains at California Property

title: Hantavirus-stricken cruise ship arrives in Tenerife

title: Influencer James Charles torched after blasting canned Spirit Airlines staffer as ‘lazy piece of s–t’ over donation plea
